verdict.rationale: Retell sends webhooks for call_started, call_ended and call_analyzed events so your server can react without polling, but the rules that decide which action to take have to live in your own code. In-product automation is narrower: agents take actions mid-call through function calling and custom functions, per-agent retention auto-deletes data after a set period, and AI QA automatically scores sampled calls against rules you configure. Missing for 10: a native user-defined event→condition→action rule builder, documented examples of configuring event-triggered actions without custom server code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
